sample.format: PE32 .NET Framework 4 client; x64 native payload embedded as length-prefixed gzip

tools: Rizin native import, xref and disassembly review
Python static substitution decode and gzip extraction
reverse_engineering.execution: Sample and embedded DLL were not executed. No controller connection was made.
reverse_engineering.obfuscation: 439 string-returning wrappers, a 97-character substitution alphabet, numerical opaque state machines, wrapper chains and junk methods. Decoded constants and compressed resources statically.

behaviors.evidence: Length-prefixed TCP messages; host inventory and screenshot/foreground-window reports; SaveInvoke, Invoke, Update, Uninstall, Exit, Disconnect and Restart handlers.

Base64 plugin bytes are saved to HKCU\Software\<host identifier>; requested plugins are loaded with AppDomain.CurrentDomain.Load, Plugin.Plugin instantiated, and Run dispatched with controller and host context.

Finds amsi.dll, resolves AmsiScanBuffer through a manual export resolver, changes protection through NtProtectVirtualMemory, then Marshal.Copy writes x64 or x86 E_INVALIDARG return stubs. Conditional on detected security software.
Separate routine targets ntdll.dll EtwEventWrite, copying x64 zero-return or x86 zero-return/20-byte stack-cleanup stubs.
WMI root\Microsoft\Windows\Defender MSFT_MpPreference Add invocation supplies ExclusionPath for installation directories and DLL. Requires sufficient privileges and enabled security context.
Copies its executable, creates scheduled tasks, writes AppInit_DLLs/LoadAppInit_DLLs/RequireSignedAppInit_DLLs, and modifies file/directory attributes and ACLs. Includes removal paths as well.
Toolhelp process traversal compares Taskmgr.exe, ProcessHacker.exe and procexp.exe. This configuration exits when found; the optional terminate branch is disabled.

embedded_payload.decompression: Read 4-byte little-endian uncompressed length (139264); gzip-decompress remaining bytes.
embedded_payload.behavior: Native x64 user-mode rootkit. Skips hosts whose image path contains its prefix; installs inline NtQuerySystemInformation and ZwQueryDirectoryFile hooks. Removes prefix-matched process entries by splicing NextEntryOffset links, and removes prefix-matched directory records by compacting output buffers.

taxonomy_change.reason: E_INVALIDARG return bytes alone do not establish AMSI impairment. Matcher and existing exclusions preserved; criticality notable for a standalone instruction-pattern observation. Intent stays in composites.
taxonomy_change.additional_native_reference: A terminated Nt/ZwQuerySystemInformation name is matched as a C-string; an import-only symbol matcher cannot represent GetProcAddress lookup targets.

limitations: Static capability analysis; does not assert successful execution on a victim.
Additional server-supplied plugins were not available; no credential-theft plugin was inferred from the remote loading capability.
Hostile patch composites infer likely AMSI/ETW impairment from architecture-specific stub pairs and native patching references even when target names are encoded.

focused_verification.native_process_filter: matched original and changed-prefix DLL; did not match after changing the SYSTEM_INFORMATION_CLASS selector from 5 to 4
focused_verification.benign_controls: Interop-only and stub-catalog controls both have zero suspicious/hostile findings

repository_validation.scope: Initial Client22 triage before the subsequent x-improve review; see x_improve_review.validation for the latest result.

hopper_disposition.embedded_payload: Already in the corrected pool; relabel returned noop, confirmed by a repeated dry-run

x_improve_review.scope: Reviewed current atomscan reports for the parent executable and extracted native DLL against the static reverse engineering evidence.
readability: AMSI, ETW and surveillance-agent descriptions name the security behavior directly.
Process lookup/Kill co-occurrence no longer claims the lookup result is terminated.
Future PE timestamp threshold is described as a calendar date instead of an epoch integer.
Opaque-resource description uses ordinary resource/decoding/interop terms.
x_improve_review.accuracy: Removed T1055 from the process-hiding rule: in-process API hooking alone does not prove process injection.

new_coverage.evidence: Native directory-query result compaction across the supported FILE_INFORMATION_CLASS layouts, directory API name, export lookup, writable code and instruction-cache synchronization.
new_coverage.generalization: No campaign filename, concealment prefix, branch target, jump-table address or copy-function address is required. The opcode sequence remains specific to this x64 implementation; alternate compiler/register layouts may require further patterns.

controls.synthetic_local_filter_only: Notable result compaction remains visible; zero suspicious/hostile findings.
controls.removed_compaction_dll: Directory-query concealment does not match; other hook-support references remain.

directory_budget_audit.consolidation: Inlined the unconsumed readdir-core and readdir-extended OR-only wrappers into their sole consumer readdir. Same eleven alternatives, scope, confidence and criticality preserved; neither wrapper had other rule or fixture consumers.

remaining_limits: Encoded configuration is documented in the assessment; no sample-specific string decoder was added to traits.
API and byte-pattern co-occurrence supports static capability inference, not successful execution or data-flow proof.
Did not add a Marshal/Copy name conjunction as proof of a write: unqualified CLR member names cannot establish the call target or direction.

validation.focused_checks: Passed original/renamed/missing-compaction DLL checks, positive synthetic hook, and both benign near misses. New hostile composite precision: 9.1. git diff --check passed.
